research_notes: 2026-10-01 avenues: official frozen range, Defence employer biography, own formal biography, direct reported 2016 interview, ABC transition report, secondary reserve chronology and targeted full-time searches. Army Research Centre contributor page supplies no substantive biography.

Obtain precise reserve-to-regular transfer, ADFA and Duntroon salaried-service periods, commissioning date, actual separation date and non-service breaks. Determine whether earlier paid civilian work exists.

Calculation note: the 2007 to August 2015 officer labels imply an elapsed boundary envelope of approximately 7.58–8.67 years (earliest/latest calendar boundaries, days divided by 365.2425); this is not a certified continuous full-time-years total, does not include pre-2007 training and is not written into the headline. No new aggregation convention is introduced.
Do not count inactive standby membership after August 2015 as full-time service. Part-time UNSW Regiment service is separate; do not sum deployment durations on top of Army tenure.
